items.quote: And the servant said unto him, Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land: must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest?
items.claim: The servant asks what to do if the woman will not follow him to this land: should he take the son back to the land Abraham came from?
items.object: whether to bring Abraham's son back to the land from whence Abraham came
items.mechanism: a conditional question about the woman being unwilling to travel

items.quote: And Abraham said unto him, Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again.
items.claim: Abraham tells the servant not to take his son back to that land.
items.object: returning his son to the land from whence Abraham came
items.mechanism: a direct instruction to the servant
